before.name: Witori: GVP confirmed eruption 1370 BCE ±160 years; date uncertain

r2SourceEvidence.review_note: GVP 1370 BCE ±160 years; W-K2 tephra, calibrated radiocarbon; GVP also lists VEI and evacuations at ±100 years; eruption VEI 6; end unknown. (?) is not a quantified interval. Moved out of destructive loader because exact year is uncertain, not because damage was impossible. Inherited point, radius and year slot do not establish vent, footprint or exact year.
